title: Water supply disruption in 3rd floor washroom
description: Employee reported no running water available in the 3rd floor west wing washrooms since 09:00 AM. Facility team notified to inspect main supply valves.

title: IPA chemical splash onto safety goggles
description: While transferring Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) in the wet bench area, a minor splash occurred. The chemical hit the technician's safety goggles. No skin or eye contact occurred due to proper PPE usage. Emergency eyewash was checked as a precaution.

title: Forklift foot injury in loading dock
description: A logistics operator's foot was caught under a moving pallet jack in the loading bay. Worker suffered a compound toe fracture and was transported to the hospital for surgical evaluation.

title: Data center cooling unit failure
description: Primary CRAC unit in Data Center B failed at 14:15. Room ambient temperature spiked to 42°C within 20 minutes, triggering automatic thermal shutdown of 15 compute racks.

title: Soldering iron minor thumb burn
description: An engineer accidentally touched the barrel of a 350°C soldering station while replacing a surface-mount capacitor. First aid applied ice and burn ointment. No medical clinic visit required.

title: Elevator entrapment between 4th and 5th floors
description: Elevator #3 stalled between floors with three employees inside. Emergency call button activated. Elevator technician arrived and freed occupants after 25 minutes. No injuries reported.

title: Nitric acid drum puncture in storage yard
description: A forklift tines punctured a 55-gallon drum of concentrated nitric acid during offloading. Approximately 20 gallons leaked onto the concrete pad before containment dike was deployed. EHS hazmat team evacuated the yard.

title: Slip on spilled tea in cafeteria entrance
description: An employee slipped on a wet tile floor near the tea dispenser. Employee fell onto knee, experiencing swelling and bruising. Sent to urgent care for X-ray; no fracture found, prescribed anti-inflammatory medication.

title: Silane gas detector low-level alarm
description: Cleanroom gas monitoring system registered a 2 ppm reading on Silane sensor S-04. Automated safety shutoff valve closed gas cylinder within 0.5 seconds. Area evacuated per protocol. Maintenance confirmed minor fitting leak.

title: High voltage arc flash in RF power lab
description: While probing a high-power RF amplifier test bench, an engineer created an unintentional short. An arc flash occurred, resulting in 2nd degree electrical burns to the engineer's right forearm. Transported to hospital burn unit.

title: Phishing email link execution contained by endpoint sandbox
description: Employee clicked a spear-phishing link in an email. The endpoint security agent isolated the browser process before credentials or network tokens could be harvested. No compromise detected.

title: Air conditioning failure in Building 5 East Wing
description: Chiller unit fault caused indoor temperatures in Building 5 2nd floor offices to rise to 29°C. Employees permitted to work remotely after 13:00 PM while repairs were conducted.

title: Fall from 2-step ladder in archiving room
description: Employee lost balance on a 2-step ladder while reaching for a box on a top shelf. Fell approximately 2 feet, landing on hip. Experienced sharp pain and inability to bear weight. X-ray confirmed hairline pelvic fracture.

title: Lithium-ion cell thermal runaway in battery test chamber
description: During stress testing, a prototype pouch cell entered thermal runaway. Automatic nitrogen suppression system activated instantly inside the explosion-proof chamber. Smoke contained within chamber exhaust.

title: Ceiling acoustic tile detachment in corridor
description: A 2x2 ceiling tile fell in the 1st floor corridor due to a slow condensation leak from an overhead chilled water pipe. Tile struck floor 1 meter behind a walking employee. No injuries.

title: Hydrofluoric acid (HF) micro-droplet contact
description: Technician noticed a pinhole tear in nitrile outer glove during HF etching process. Minor redness observed on index finger tip. Calcium gluconate gel applied immediately. Employee sent to occupational health clinic for evaluation.

title: Pantry microwave electrical spark and odor
description: A microwave in 4th floor pantry sparked and emitted burnt plastic smell when turned on. Appliance unplugged immediately and tagged out for replacement. No fire or injury.

title: ESD strap cord tripping hazard in PCB lab
description: Unanchored ESD grounding wire stretched across lab aisle. A visiting contractor tripped, resulting in a small laceration on palm when breaking the fall. Cleaned and bandaged with first aidkit.

title: Campus backbone fiber cable severed during trenching
description: External civil construction crew cut an underground fiber optic conduit. Caused complete loss of internet and internal network connectivity for campus Buildings 1 through 4 for 6 hours.

title: Heavy equipment rack collapse during installation
description: While unboxing a 400kg server rack, the transport pallet broke. Rack fell onto a technician, causing severe crush injuries to lower torso and internal hemorrhaging. Technician pronounced deceased at scene.

title: Restroom tap handle broken off
description: Tap handle in 2nd floor men's room broke, causing continuous flow of water into basin. Plumber shut valve within 15 minutes. No overflow or flooding.

title: Class 3B laser reflection hazard
description: An optic alignment mirror slipped on an optical bench, directing a 532nm laser beam towards an unshielded doorway. Safety interlock circuit tripped laser power off instantly when doorway sensor broke.

title: High-pressure pneumatic line dislodgement
description: A 100 PSI pneumatic air hose disconnected from fitting due to missing safety clip. Hose whipped wildly and struck an engineer in the face, causing facial laceration and fractured orbital bone.

title: Unencrypted USB drive found in parking lot
description: Security officer picked up a flash drive near gate 2. Plugs into isolation forensic rig revealed employee personal files. Returned to owner with reminder on policy.

title: Automatic entrance sliding door sensor malfunction
description: Main entrance glass door closed rapidly while employee was passing through, bumping employee's shoulder. No bruising or injury reported. Sensor sensitivity recalibrated.

title: Wafer cassette dropped inside laminar flow hood
description: Operator dropped a cassette containing 25 silicon test wafers. Wafers shattered into microscopic glass shards. Area isolated and HEPA vacuumed. Operator wore full cleanroom suit; no skin contact.

title: Finger pinched in automated IC handler door
description: Technician reached into IC handler unit to clear a pin jam without turning off main power. Safety interlock failed. Door mechanism pinched index finger, causing deep crush wound and nail bed tearing. Treated at clinic with 5 stitches.

title: Overheated power supply smoking in test rig
description: Benchtop DC power supply capacitor blew, emitting heavy smoke and foul odor. Operator flipped main circuit breaker. No flame propagation.

title: Water leak in server room ceiling from upper floor pantry
description: A clogged sink on 3rd floor leaked water through floor slab into 2nd floor server room. Dripped onto top of rack cabinet #4. Drip tray deployed; zero equipment damage.

title: Employee fainting during outdoor antenna calibration
description: During midday outdoor testing in 38°C heat, an engineer suffered heat exhaustion and fainted, striking head on gravel walkway. Sustained loss of consciousness and concussion. Admitted to hospital for 24-hour monitoring.

title: Jam in paper shredder causing motor smoke
description: Heavy-duty paper shredder jammed in HR department, causing electric motor to overheat and release minor smoke. Unplugged by staff; maintenance replaced shredder unit.

title: Acetone container left unstoppered overnight
description: 500ml glass bottle of acetone was left uncapped inside fume hood overnight. Fume hood airflow remained active, safely exhausting all vapors. Discovered by morning shift.

title: Scaffolding collapse during exterior window cleaning
description: A 3-story exterior staging rig failed due to snapped support cable. Two window cleaning contractors fell 30 feet to pavement. Both suffered fatal traumatic injuries upon impact.

title: Capacitor bank explosion in high power test bay
description: 450V electrolytic capacitor exploded inside shielded enclosure during over-voltage qualification test. Metal shrapnel contained inside metal enclosure door. Operator behind acrylic shield unharmed.

title: Pigeon trapped in HVAC air intake shaft
description: Bird got trapped in rooftop fresh air intake ducting, causing slight odor in 4th floor conference room. Maintenance removed bird and sanitized ductwork.

title: Solvent splash into operator's eye during manual wash
description: While rinsing PCB with isopropyl alcohol, a droplet splashed under safety glasses into operator's left eye. Immediate 15-minute flushing at eyewash station. Eye doctor confirmed minor corneal abrasion, prescribed antibiotic drops.

title: UPS battery cell leakage in basement power room
description: Routine inspection found electrolyte leaking from 2 valve-regulated lead-acid batteries in main UPS bank. Neutralizing agent applied. Batteries isolated and replaced.

title: Hand paper towel dispenser detached from wall
description: Towel dispenser fell off drywall anchor when pulled by user, landing on sink counter. No injuries.

title: Toxic gas scrubbers water recirculation failure
description: Scrubber pump tripped due to thermal overload. Automatic safety interlocks halted all gas flow from etching tools immediately. No untreated toxic gas escaped stack.

title: Worker crushed between reversing forklift and loading bay door
description: Forklift driver reversed without checking blind spot, pinning a pedestrian worker against a concrete pillar. Worker suffered severe crushing injury to chest cavity and pelvic bone, requiring emergency surgery and ICU placement.

title: Foul odor in basement corridor near drain
description: Dry P-trap in basement utility room allowed sewer gas smell to enter hallway. Water poured into drain to restore seal; smell dissipated within 1 hour.

title: Wire stripper nick on technician thumb
description: Technician slipped while stripping 18 AWG copper wire, causing small cut on thumb. Cleaned with antiseptic and applied adhesive bandage from lab first aid kit.

title: Unauthenticated device connected to lab ethernet port
description: Network access control (NAC) system blocked an unknown MAC address plugged into Lab 3 wall jack within 2 seconds. Investigation revealed vendor laptop plugged in without guest registration.

title: Fluorescent light ballast hum and flicker
description: Overhead light fixture in cubicle area 3B flickered and produced high-pitched hum. Facilities replaced fixture ballast after hours.

title: Laceration from utility knife during box unboxing
description: Contractor slipped while cutting cardboard box tape with exposed utility blade. Blade cut left palm, requiring 6 stitches at local urgent care center.

title: DI water purification system pressure spike
description: Deionized water loop relief valve opened into floor drain following regulator failure. Water flow shut off manually within 5 minutes. No cleanroom contamination.

title: RF chamber door pinch point injury
description: Heavy shielded door of anechoic chamber swung shut due to faulty latch pin, catching engineer's hand. Resulted in crushed finger bones requiring surgical pinning and 3 days hospitalization.

title: Low water pressure on 4th floor drinking fountains
description: Water pressure dropped in water coolers on 4th floor due to booster pump filter clogging. Filter replaced by facilities within 2 hours.

title: Small solvent spill during PCB manual cleaning
description: Approximately 100ml of ethanol spilled onto ESD bench work surface. Operator wiped up spill using solvent absorbent pads while wearing chemical-resistant gloves. Ventilated area.

title: Main core router power module failure
description: Primary power supply unit on core router failed. Redundant secondary PSU took over seamlessly with zero packet loss or downtime.

title: Car park gate arm failure
description: Barrier gate at car park entrance stuck in down position due to motor gear failure. Traffic rerouted through exit gate for 1 hour.

title: Vacuum chamber implosion during bake-out test
description: Glass view port on vacuum chamber fractured under ultra-high vacuum conditions. Shrapnel contained by acrylic safety shield around chamber. Operator unharmed.

title: Overhead gantry crane cable snap during motor lift
description: A 500kg motor dropped 10 feet when a worn hoist wire rope snapped. Struck maintenance technician below. Technician sustained fatal head trauma.

title: Thermal camera battery swelling during charging
description: Li-ion battery inside handheld thermal camera swelled significantly while on charging dock. Disconnected from power and moved to sand bucket in battery storage area.

title: Loose handrail on staircase between 2nd and 3rd floor
description: Employee noted wall-mounted handrail wobbling significantly when pulled. Facilities tightened mounting bolts immediately.

title: Inhalation of flux fumes in poorly ventilated rework area
description: Technician worked 4 hours soldering PCBs without activating local fume extraction unit. Experienced dizziness, nausea, and shortness of breath. Sent home for rest after medical evaluation.

title: SAN storage array controller failover
description: Primary storage controller experienced kernel panic. Secondary controller took over; short latency spike of 2 seconds observed across network shares.

title: Cafeteria refrigerator door seal failure
description: Walk-in cooler door seal tore, causing temperature to rise to 8°C. Perishable food items transferred to secondary cooler; seal replaced.

title: Emergency stop button pressed accidentally
description: Cleanroom technician bumped E-stop button with shoulder while moving equipment. Tool shut down safely. Restarted after 30-minute qualification check.

title: Electrical shock from improperly grounded 480V panel
description: Electrician touched enclosure frame of ungrounded 480V switchgear panel. Sustained severe shock, cardiac arrhythmia, and internal electrical burns. Transported to hospital intensive care unit.

title: Automatic flush valve stuck open in restroom
description: Sensor flush valve in 1st floor restroom ran continuously. Water shut off at isolation valve pending solenoid replacement.

title: SMD hot air rework tool scorching lab bench mat
description: Hot air nozzle left facing bench surface at 400°C for 2 minutes. Scorched ESD rubber mat, causing minor smoke and burning smell. No open flame.

title: Badge reader malfunction at secure server room entrance
description: RFID reader on Server Room 1 door failed to recognize valid badges. Security guard posted at door while electronic lock was serviced.

title: Window blind cord snapped
description: Pull cord on office window blinds snapped while lowering shade. Blinds fixed in mid position until repaired.

title: Fall on icy outdoor sidewalk near building entrance
description: During winter freeze, an employee slipped on black ice on entrance walkway. Sustained fractured wrist requiring cast and urgent care treatment.

title: Isopropanol bath ignition from static discharge
description: Static spark ignited small open bath of IPA on wet bench. Automatic fire lid closed over bath within 1 second, extinguishing flame immediately.

title: Pinched finger in pneumatic IC handler arm
description: Engineer's ring finger tip pinched while adjusting pick-and-place nozzle. Caused blood blister and nail bruising. Ice applied at lab first aid station.

title: Carpet seam lifting in high-traffic hallway
description: Lifting carpet seam created 1-inch ridge in hallway floor. Facilities taped down edge pending carpet repair.

title: Ammonia gas leak during chiller maintenance
description: Refrigeration technician accidentally sheared a pressure relief valve on main ammonia chiller. Ammonia gas rapidly filled basement plant room. One technician suffered fatal chemical asphyxiation.

title: NAS drive failure in development server cluster
description: Single SAS hard drive failed in RAID 6 array. Hot spare drive automatically rebuilt array within 4 hours; no data loss.

title: No hot water in cafeteria dishwashing area
description: Commercial water heater element failed. Kitchen staff used temporary electric water booster unit to maintain sanitation standards.

title: High current cable overheating and insulation melt
description: 50A cable carrying 80A during over-stress test melted rubber insulation, causing short to bench chassis. Fused circuit opened; power cut.

title: Struck by falling metal conduit during renovation
description: Contractor dropped 10-foot electrical conduit from ceiling grid. Conduit struck worker's hard hat and shoulder. Hard hat prevented head injury; shoulder contusion treated at clinic.

title: DI water spill on cleanroom floor
description: Flex hose popped off deionized water valve, spilling approximately 5 gallons of water onto cleanroom raised floor. Cleaned up with squeegee and mop.

title: Automatic faucet sensor battery dead
description: Faucet in 3rd floor west washroom inoperative due to flat sensor battery. Battery replaced by maintenance.

title: Sulfuric acid bath over-heating
description: Temperature controller failed ON, causing sulfuric acid bath to boil at 180°C. Fume hood exhaust contained acidic vapors. High-temp cutoff switch tripped heater power.

title: Probing needle puncture on thumb
description: Engineer slipped while positioning micro-probing needle under microscope, puncturing thumb tip. Cleaned with alcohol wipe and applied bandage.

title: Executive conference room projector bulb pop
description: Ceiling projector lamp blew with a loud pop during meeting. Replacement unit installed by IT support.

title: Trapped arm in powered rolling storage shelving unit
description: Employee activated electric moveable filing system while colleague was inside aisle. Emergency safety bumper failed to stop shelf. Employee's arm crushed, sustaining compound humerus fracture requiring surgery.

title: DNS server process crash
description: Internal primary DNS daemon crashed due to memory leak. Secondary DNS server handled queries automatically until daemon watchdog restarted primary service in 15 seconds.

title: Water fountain drain slow drainage
description: Drinking fountain basin filled slowly due to clogged drain strainer. Strainer cleared by janitorial team.

title: Compressed air line regulator diaphragm tear
description: Regulator diaphragm ruptured with loud hiss. Pressure relief valve vented harmlessly. Line isolated.

title: Chemical splash from pressurized line disconnect
description: Technician uncoupled chemical transfer line without verifying zero pressure state. Potassium hydroxide solution sprayed onto face and chest. Emergency shower used immediately. Sustained severe chemical burns and permanent partial blindness.

title: Oscilloscope power cord insulation damage
description: Power cord outer sheath split exposing inner insulated wires. Cable removed and destroyed.

title: Pantry soap dispenser leak on floor
description: Liquid soap dispenser dripped onto tile floor creating small slippery spot. Cleaned up and dispenser replaced.

title: Argon gas cylinder valve protective cap missing during transport
description: Full argon cylinder moved on hand cart without protective valve cap installed. Moved safely to rack; safety cap attached.

title: Thermal burn from heatsink on power amplifier test board
description: Engineer touched 90°C aluminum heatsink on RF board during live test. Sustained 1st degree burn on palm. Cooled with tap water.

title: Office door latch sticking shut
description: Door latch stuck on office 412, preventing door from opening from inside. Maintenance retracted latch from outside after 10 minutes.

title: Finger tip amputation in motorized sheet metal shear
description: Operator fed sheet metal into foot-pedal operated shear. Hand slipped under guard. Shear blade amputated distal phalanx of right index finger. Emergency transport to hand trauma center for micro-surgery.

title: Storage expansion rack power cable trip hazard
description: Temporary power cord stretched across server aisle without cable ramp during upgrade. Contractor tripped but did not fall or unplug cable.

title: Window lock handle loose in 5th floor office
description: Window sash lock handle loose. Tightened by maintenance technician to secure window.

title: Developer solvent fume hood exhaust airflow drop alarm
description: Exhaust fan belt slipped, reducing airflow in hood 4. Alarm sounded; process halted and chemical containers capped.

title: Toxic gas release following exhaust system power failure
description: Backup power failed to start during main grid blackout while arsine gas process was active. Arsine gas vented into unventilated room. Three semiconductor technicians suffered fatal toxic exposure.

title: BGA rework station vacuum pickup failure
description: Vacuum nozzle dropped heated IC chip back onto board from 1 inch height. Component damaged; no operator injury.

title: Cafeteria napkin dispenser spring pop
description: Spring mechanism popped out of napkin holder onto table. No injury.

title: Waste solvent carboy overfill
description: Technician filled 20L waste carboy past fill line, resulting in 200ml overflow into secondary containment tray. Wiped up with spill pads.

title: Logic analyzer probe cable pin prick
description: Sharp ground clip pin pricked engineer's index finger while attaching to IC lead. Minor drop of blood; cleaned with alcohol wipe.

title: Stall door lock missing in 2nd floor restroom
description: Latch missing on stall door in 2nd floor restroom. Latch replaced by facilities.

title: NTP time server sync drift
description: Internal time server drifted 4 seconds from UTC due to loss of GPS lock. Resynced automatically via secondary upstream NTP pool.

title: Structural mezzanine floor collapse under heavy battery bank
description: Mezzanine floor failed under a 3-ton battery bank load. Structural collapse crushed two engineers working below, resulting in fatal injuries.
